REQUIRED-DOC: The parser accepts HTML and an optional base URL. The local path does not access the network.

## Example

```json
{"source":"html","mode":"balanced"}
```

## Parameters

| Name | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| source | Input HTML |
| mode | Cleanup policy |

REQUIRED-DOC-END: Rendering happens after extraction so changing output format cannot alter content selection.
